name: Hachimiya Yellow de Cherish
original_name: 八宮・イエロード・チェリシュ
source:
She is nicknamed as Cherry. She is a free spirit and often childish. Hates school and test while loves to play around. Grandfather is American and in the military that is often over protective. Due to her background is an excellent athlete and loves to compete anything sports related. 

Likes: Crustacean
Dislikes: Inflexible people
Hobbies: Making fun of others
